note: Wayne County, MS publishes no queryable zoning district polygons. The county's only zoning item on ArcGIS Online (owner cullen-waynecty.gis, 'Zoning', a Vector Tile Service at vectortileservices1.arcgis.com/VMKRr2Ecl6EFwJpm) is an overlay showing whether each municipality has zoning, with links to PDFs, not district polygons. The city of Waynesboro, the county seat and the only sizable zoning city found, publishes its ten-district zoning ordinance and its 2012 Official Zoning Map only as PDF files. Clara and Buckatunna are unincorporated and have no city zoning. The county's Tri-State-hosted parcel viewer and Wayne County open data hub show no zoning district layer.
